title: Felix and the Silence
author: Mirabel Brightwater
blurb: Casper Blackwood, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
